svg.text: Like B, but the API sends to Service Bus itself after COMMIT, and the sweeper resends a lost message. One ZIP per document (stored, no compression: PNG bytes and page hashes unchanged). Statuses: Uploaded (UI: "processing") → Blocked | PendingReview → Approved, or Failed; results are stored at PendingReview, only Approved ones are read. Alternatives are alt frames; red ✗ = state after an infrastructure failure. Service Bus Basic has no duplicate detection: receivers are idempotent. SLA targets are proposals (p95).
Mask in the browser · measured: 6–8 s/page on a phone, 11–28 s/page on a 2017 laptop
1. render, OCR, zone masking, leak check; user approves the masked pages; pack them into a ZIP
✗ nothing was sent: no state anywhere, the user starts again
Browser closed here: nothing is lost on the server,
because nothing was sent. The original stays on the device.
2. POST /documents (application/zip: pages/{pageSha}.png + manifest.json { order[], keptRegions[], originalSha256 })
✗ network error: nothing stored, or stored and the UI does not know it; the retry lands in "already uploaded" below
3. unzip in memory: stored entries only, names from the manifest, PNG only, sizes; recompute page hashes
5. SELECT Document WHERE userId=@me AND originalSha256=@h
✗ SQL paused: waits for it to wake up; on timeout 503, UI retries
6. 200 { docId, verId, status } (existing document; UI offers to open it)
7. docId, verId = new UUIDv7 (Guid.CreateVersion7), generated before any write
✗ API dies here: orphan ZIP, no row; the lifecycle deletes it after 24 h
9. TX: INSERT Document (UNIQUE userId + originalSha256), Version(Uploaded); COMMIT
✗ rollback: no row, orphan ZIP as above; 500, UI retries. Unique violation (parallel retry): 200 with the existing document
10. send check: CheckRequested { userId, docId, verId }
✗ API dies after COMMIT: Uploaded without a message; the sweeper sends it
✗ response lost: the document exists, the UI finds it in the list
[invalid: not a stored ZIP, not PNG, unknown name, page hash ≠ manifest]
Browser closed after 202: the server carries on.
Next visit: the list shows the current status.
Checker · target: Blocked, or handed to the extractor, within 1 min of the upload
✗ checker down: message waits in the queue; status stays Uploaded
15. send extract: ExtractRequested { userId, docId, verId, extId } (again; the extractor is idempotent)
[clean ZIP exists: the earlier try passed it, maybe crashed before reporting]
[no clean ZIP: the earlier try blocked or failed it and reported it, or the document was deleted]
17. verify page hashes, shape check, OCR + zone rules (in memory, nothing stored)
19. send extract: ExtractRequested { userId, docId, verId, extId }
✗ crash before sending: redelivered, the resume alt sends it
20. send status: Blocked { userId, docId, verId, regions[]: {page,x,y,w,h,rule} }
21. send status: Failed { userId, docId, verId, reason: integrity }
[blocked: ink outside the kept regions, or personal data found by OCR]
[broken: a page hash or PNG does not match]
✗ not deleted: the lifecycle removes it after 24 h
[incoming ZIP missing: an earlier try got this far]
23. abandon: Service Bus delivers it again later
24. send status: Failed { userId, docId, verId, reason: check_error }
[an exception (OCR error, out of memory caught) and deliveryCount < 5]
✗ not completed (crash): delivered again; the first alt finds the work done
No "Checked" status: a clean document goes straight on to the extractor.
One version gets exactly one of: Blocked, Extracted, Failed.
✗ API asleep or down: the event waits in the queue; status unchanged
28. UPDATE Version SET Blocked + regions | Failed + reason WHERE verId AND status=Uploaded
29. complete; the UI sees the new status on its next poll
[0 rows: a duplicate, an old version, or the document was deleted]
Extractor · target: PendingReview within 3 min of the upload
31. ExtractRequested { userId, docId, verId, extId } + deliveryCount
✗ extractor down: waits; status stays Uploaded
34. send status: Extracted { userId, docId, verId, extId, results[] } (from the saved results; no DI, no OpenAI)
37. build an image-only PDF of all pages in memory (never stored)
✗ DI down or 429: see the error alt below
39. { pages[]: words, lines, tables, bbox } (page number → pageSha by manifest order)
40. chat(masked text of all pages, JSON schema)
✗ OpenAI down or 429: see the error alt below
41. { results[]: name, value, unit, range, dates, pageSha, bbox }
42. validate with pydantic: schema, numbers, units, dates
46. PUT text/{userId}/{docId}/{verId}.json { words[] per pageSha, results[] }
47. send status: Extracted { userId, docId, verId, extId, results[] }
48. send status: Failed { userId, docId, verId, reason: extract_invalid }
[clean ZIP missing: the document was deleted meanwhile]
[results already saved: an earlier try crashed before reporting]
50. send status: Failed { userId, docId, verId, reason: extract_error }
[DI or OpenAI error (429, 5xx, timeout) and deliveryCount < 5]
✗ not completed (crash): delivered again; the first alt resends from the saved results
✗ API asleep or down: the event waits in the queue; status unchanged
53. TX: INSERT Extraction, LabResult[] (PendingReview) | SET Failed WHERE status=Uploaded; COMMIT
54. complete; the UI sees the new status on its next poll
[0 rows: a duplicate, an old version, or the document was deleted]
Review (user): are the values the AI extracted correct? · no SLA: waits for a person
The masking was approved in the browser before the upload.
Here the user checks only the extracted values against the masked pages.
✗ API asleep: waits for the cold start
57. SELECT Version, Extraction, LabResult[] WHERE userId=@me AND docId AND current version
62. "This document was deleted", back to the list
67. show values without highlighting (the review still works)
69. unzip (JSZip); each value next to its place on the page; user corrects values or rejects rows
Browser closed during review: corrections are lost,
status stays PendingReview, the user starts the review again.
✗ network error: still PendingReview, UI retries (rowVersion makes a repeat harmless)
✗ OpenAI down: 503, nothing written; still PendingReview, UI retries
74. TX: UPDATE results; SET Approved WHERE status=PendingReview AND rowVersion=@rv; INSERT Fragment(text, vector)[]; COMMIT
✗ response lost: approved anyway; the UI shows it on refresh
77. already Approved: show it; otherwise reload the review (corrections kept in the form)
[0 rows: approved already (a retry), or rowVersion changed (new extraction, another tab)]
[ZIP missing: the document was deleted meanwhile]
Approved is final: nothing else is sent, so there is no outbox and no gap here.
Fragments and vectors are written in the same transaction: no indexing stage.
U5 · Browse results and trends (most frequent: ~60 reads per import) · target: < 1 s when warm; a long cold start is accepted
After idle time the API container and the serverless SQL are asleep:
the first request waits for them to start (accepted, not measured).
✗ API asleep: waits for the cold start; UI shows a spinner
79. SELECT LabResult WHERE userId=@me AND status=Approved AND parameterId=@p ORDER BY date
✗ SQL paused: wakes up, the request waits; on timeout 503, UI retries
81. chart; out-of-range marked by flag (computed by code, not by a model)
82. GET /documents/{docId}/versions/{verId}/pages (user clicks a point: the source page)
85. refresh the chart; the point is gone
86. ZIP (masked pages); UI opens the page {pageSha}
U6 · Ask the agent (~5 questions per import) · target: first words < 3 s, full answer < 15 s when warm
87. check the question: PESEL, e-mail, phone, address
88. block, explain what to remove (nothing sent)
89. POST /chat { question, history[] } (SSE stream; the history lives in the browser tab only)
✗ network error: nothing stored anywhere, the user asks again
90. the same identifier check (the browser is not trusted)
✗ OpenAI down or 429: 503, UI says "try again"; nothing stored
93. tool_call get_trend("vitamin D", from, to) | search_text("comment about the sample")
94. SELECT … WHERE userId=@me AND status=Approved (same queries as U5)
✗ SQL paused: waits; on timeout the tool returns an error and the model says so
97. SELECT TOP 5 … WHERE userId=@me AND status=Approved ORDER BY VECTOR_DISTANCE(cosine, embedding, @v)
100. guardrail: every number must match a tool result, every claim must be cited
✗ stream broken: partial answer, UI offers "ask again"; nothing stored
102. stream: the raw results table + "ask your doctor"
103. SELECT Version WHERE status=Uploaded AND updatedAt < now() − 3 min
104. send check: CheckRequested { userId, docId, verId } (again; the checker is idempotent)
105. UPDATE SET resends = resends + 1, updatedAt = now()
plaintext original or unmasked personal data
note: a fact, e.g. the user closes the browser
✗ if this step fails: state of the system
